title: Count Pairs in Two Arrays
description:

Return *the **number of pairs** satisfying the condition.*

- (0, 1) where 1 + 10 > 1 + 4.
- (0, 2) where 1 + 6 > 1 + 1.
- (1, 2) where 10 + 6 > 4 + 1.
